Built a complete bookmark manager called **Stash**.

Features include:

- Add, edit, and delete bookmarks
- Search across titles, domains, notes, and tags
- Favorites and read-later filters
- Collection organization
- Grid and list layouts
- Sorting controls
- Persistent browser storage
- Responsive mobile design
- Polished empty states, menus, and notifications

The production build passes, and the add/search workflow was verified in Chromium without console errors.

Open the app at [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000).

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
    page = browser.new_page(viewport={\"width\": 1440, \"height\": 1000}, device_scale_factor=1)
    errors=[]
    page.on('console', lambda msg: errors.append(f'console:{msg.type}:{msg.text}') if msg.type=='error' else None)
    page.on('pageerror', lambda err: errors.append(f'pageerror:{err}'))
    page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:4000', wait_until='networkidle')
    page.wait_for_selector('[data-harness-ready=\"true\"]')
    page.screenshot(path='/work/app-preview.png', full_page=True)
    cards = page.locator('.card').count()
    page.get_by_role('button', name='Add bookmark').first.click()
    page.get_by_label('URL').fill('example.com/story')
    page.get_by_label('Title').fill('A test bookmark')
    page.get_by_role('button', name='Save bookmark').click()
    page.wait_for_selector('text=Bookmark saved')
    assert page.locator('.card').count() == cards + 1
    page.get_by_label('Search bookmarks').fill('test bookmark')
    assert page.locator('.card').count() == 1
    print({'cards_initial': cards, 'add_and_search': 'ok', 'errors': errors})
    browser.close()
